name: Death Game Royale
source:
Accused of crimes you didn't commit, you suddenly find yourself fighting for your life alongside actual criminals! The only way to survive these death games is to assemble a team, but how do you know who to trust?

As you begin to work together, you notice your teammates are looking at you as more than just an ally. Will you sweep them away with your sharp wits and charm or will you lead them to purgatory?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.brunner&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dbrunner_web]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
被指控犯有你没有犯下的罪行，你突然发现自己与真正的罪犯一起为自己的生命而战！在这些死亡游戏中生存的唯一方法是组建一支团队，但你如何知道该信任谁呢？

当你们开始一起工作时，你注意到你的队友不仅仅将你视为盟友。你会用你的智慧和魅力扫除他们还是将他们带入炼狱？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.brunner&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dbrunner_web]Google Play[/url]]
